experiences.title: Internal Audit Intern
experiences.description: Supported risk-based internal audits across five departments (IT, Multifamily, Accounting, Finance and HR), performing control testing, evidence review and workpaper documentation. Tested the organization's AI copilot against governance requirements (access, data sharing, acceptable use, output reliability and bias metrics); documented exceptions with risk ratings, remediation timelines and management action items. Tested 15+ disbursements for approval, supporting documentation and correct coding, using sample-based control tests of 10+ items each. Evaluated Risk & Control Matrices (RCMs), acceptable-use policies and control effectiveness of software deployments; followed up with control owners on remediation of 3+ audit findings. Executed design and operating effectiveness testing across key financial statement assertions; documented audit trails and resolved 8 balance sheet reconciliation exceptions during fieldwork. Maintained the risk register in Optro (15+ risks tracked by rating, control owner and remediation status across business units); authored an Optro user manual to standardize audit procedures.

experiences.title: Financial Analyst
experiences.description: Reviewed 500+ vendor invoices monthly for GST input-credit eligibility and coordinated tax reconciliations with external auditors. Performed subsequent disbursements testing on post-year-end expenditures exceeding INR 25 Cr+, verifying invoice dates and receiving logs to validate completeness of accrued liabilities and cutoff integrity. Prepared GST, TDS and income tax filings in Tally, Zoho Books and QuickBooks, maintaining supporting documentation for compliance reviews.

experiences.title: Accounting Analyst
experiences.description: Facilitated statutory audit PBC deliverables, performing balance sheet substantiation and multi-party debtor/creditor reconciliations across INR 50 Cr+ balances under Ind AS and Schedule III guidelines. Reconciled purchase registers with GSTR-2B reports to verify Input Tax Credit (ITC) eligibility and ensure accurate period-end statutory tax accruals.
